naics: 334511 - Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufactur
requirements_title: Maritime Approaches Surveillance Systems (MAST) New Work
requirement:
The scope of work includes the rapid production and deployment of MAST systems and transitioning deployed systems into steady-state O&S across current and future MAST sensor coverage zones. A MAST system uses commercial off-the-shelf sensor technologies, including maritime surface search radars, EO/IR cameras, encrypted AIS receivers, a Mission Management System, and payload platforms. Data is transmitted via a DHS-accredited network to authorized DHS operation centers. MAST systems operate 24/7/365 and include radar, camera, communications, supportability, power, and remote health-monitoring equipment. They are designed to meet cybersecurity requirements, withstand harsh coastal and marine environments, and operate on commercial or solar power with generator backup. Systems are deployed at strategic coastal sites using elevated terrain and site-specific configurations, such as towers, monopoles, tripods, raised platforms, or buildings, to maximize overlapping radar and camera coverage.
